Samantha, thanks again for taking the call today. Below is a concise recap so we have aligned expectations going into the technical deep‑dive: 

Key pain points you mentioned
- Existing inference load on smaller models spikes latency during peak business hours (scheduling/triage flows).
- Regulatory mandate requires PHI to remain in‑country and logged; audit window 7 years.
- One line item from compliance: possible air‑gap requirement for certain workloads (radiology PII) — you flagged this as "possible" for Q4.

Goals we agreed on
- Validate whether Redwood Private (VPC or on‑prem package) can meet the data residency + audit log needs.
- Confirm network topology constraints (eg: no outbound interfaces from the air‑gapped cluster; restricted egress to a jump host).
- Run a short tech‑deep dive with your infra/CISO team to map a feasible architecture and risk areas.

Open technical constraints you shared
- Primary: No direct internet egress from the isolated environment. Updates must come via secure transfer.
- Secondary: VPN only to a dedicated bastion in the us‑east-1 region (Arden’s preferred region).
- KMS: Arden prefers HSM‑backed key management; need to validate compatibility.

Proposed next steps (I can own coordination)
1) Technical deep‑dive: 60m session — attendees: your infra lead (David), your CISO, our Private deployments engineer (Marissa Cole), and me. Target: Thu 2028-03-22 10:00 AM ET.
2) Exchange a sanitized network diagram / ACLs (you to drop first pass; I attached a blank template).
3) Share compliance packet: SOC2 summary, data retention controls, and our HSM integrations doc. I'll attach our short Private deploy one‑pager.

Attachments: arden_network_diagram.png (blank template), redwood_private-deploy-summary.pdf (one‑pager)

If that schedule works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda for the technical call.
